records.name: Kenya
records.summary_text: Kenya is a dangerous destination for trans visitors. Same-sex conduct is criminalised under the colonial-era Penal Code (14 years, applies to all including tourists). Police extortion targeting trans people is documented and systemic — a trans woman was forced to pay a $50 bribe in Mombasa, and 25 trans and intersex people told CNN this kind of police harassment is "common." The Kenya Human Rights Commission's "Lives on the Line" report documented 102 evictions, 43 unlawful arrests, and mob violence (groups stripping queer people naked) over a one-year period.
